item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies turn mostly clear with low temperatures ranging from the lower twenties to the upper twenties and no precipitation expected. Tomorrow brings partly to mostly cloudy conditions and highs from the lower fifties to the mid-fifties, with only a slight chance of rain. Looking ahead to tomorrow night, expect mostly clear skies and lows in the upper thirties to lower forties, with precipitation remaining minimal.
